summary.text: Nathan and Cameron discussed focusing the hackathon demo on audio-only virtual office conversations, excluding video and Teams integration due to admin permission blockers.
They agreed on using a Slack-style message draft preview requiring human approval rather than sending actual messages.
Cameron committed to updating the LiveKit transcript export, while Nathan committed to building the draft preview. A proposed new demo script was cancelled in favor of an existing recording.

decisions.text: Ship audio-only virtual office conversations for the demo, postponing video implementation.
Use a Slack-style message draft preview requiring human approval without actually sending messages.
Use the existing recording for the demo rather than creating a new script.

actionItems.text: Add speaker IDs and timestamps to the LiveKit transcript export.
